metadata.title: XRL-IDARS DQN and Autonomous Response Multi-Scenario Validation

RQ7_relative_cost_reduction_target_15pct.target: >= 15.0% cost reduction vs best deterministic baseline
RQ7_relative_cost_reduction_target_15pct.finding: Achieves statistically significant cost reduction (+11.29% to +14.10% on test population, p < 0.001), but does not meet >= 15.0% practical threshold against Baseline 2 (Two-Tier).

RQ7_1_action_chattering_index_target.finding: Observed ACI = 0.0214 in 4-action mode, exceeding 0.01 threshold. 3-action mode achieves 0.0019 (PASS).

RQ7_2_false_quarantine_rate_target.target: < 2.0% false isolation rate on benign traffic
RQ7_2_false_quarantine_rate_target.finding: Observed FQR = 0.20% on test population, 0.00% on benign baseline. Strictly within limit.

RQ7_3_deterministic_safety_gate_complian.target: 100% compliance with zero critical host isolations and blast radius cap
RQ7_3_deterministic_safety_gate_complian.finding: 100% compliance observed across all scenarios. Critical hosts (gateway, DNS) were protected via 100% safety overrides.
